description: Call a single firmware store action on the app store (e.g. updateReceiverChannel, updateSenderChannel, changeSwitchState). Immediately applies to the editor config. MUTATING. Use firmware_edit_actions first to get the exact arg signature (positional args, enums like receiverKey/actuator) for the action you want.

action.description: Store action name, e.g. updateReceiverChannel. See firmware_edit_actions.

args.description: Positional arguments for the action, in the documented order.
